gestures.name: explain
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and talks with both hands, moving them in front of the chest and opening the palms outward.

gestures.name: laugh
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and laughs heartily, the shoulders shaking, leaning back slightly and then forward with a hand on the belly.

gestures.name: yawn
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place, raises both arms overhead stretching while yawning, then lowers the arms.

gestures.name: stretch
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place, interlocks the fingers, stretches both arms forward and then straight up, and relaxes.

gestures.name: dance
gestures.prompt: A person dances happily in place, swaying the hips side to side and moving both arms to the rhythm.

gestures.name: look_around
gestures.prompt: A person stands still and turns the head to the left, then to the right, looking around, then faces forward again.

gestures.name: sigh
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place, drops the shoulders and lowers the head with a deep breath out, then straightens up.

gestures.name: excited
gestures.prompt: A person bounces on the toes in place and shakes both fists quickly in front of the chest.

gestures.name: salute
gestures.prompt: A person stands straight and raises the right hand to the forehead in a military salute, then lowers it.

gestures.name: fist_pump
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and pumps the right fist up in the air twice.

gestures.name: stop
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and raises the right hand in front of the body with the palm facing forward, holding it there, then lowers it.

gestures.name: come_here
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and beckons with the right hand, waving it toward the body several times.

gestures.name: scratch_head
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place, raises the right hand and scratches the back of the head, then lowers the hand.

gestures.name: hands_on_hips
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and puts both hands on the hips, leaning slightly forward.

gestures.name: shiver
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place hugging themselves with both arms and shivers, rubbing the upper arms.

gestures.name: air_guitar
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place playing air guitar, strumming quickly with the right hand while the left hand holds the neck of the guitar out to the side.

gestures.name: shy
gestures.prompt: A person stands with the hands clasped behind the back, sways gently side to side and lowers the head.

gestures.name: sneeze
gestures.prompt: A person tilts the head back, then jerks the head and torso forward in a sneeze, covering the mouth with the right hand.

gestures.name: dab
gestures.prompt: A person does a dab: the head dips into the bent left elbow while the right arm extends straight up and out to the side, then returns.

gestures.name: point_self
gestures.prompt: A person stands in place and points at their own chest with the right index finger, then lowers the hand.
